name: Forge The Egg!
desc:
🔨 FORGE THE EGG! 🥚

Welcome to FORGE THE EGG

Are you ready to become the strongest Egg Blacksmith?

🥚 **FORGE YOUR EGGS!**  
Use your hammer to forge eggs and make them stronger!

⚡ **UPGRADE YOUR EGGS!**  
Keep upgrading your eggs to unlock incredible power and rarity!

🐉 **HATCH YOUR EGGS!**  
Hatch your powerful eggs and discover what's inside!

💰 **EARN MONEY!**  
Collect rewards from your hatched eggs and build your fortune!

🔨 **BUY BETTER HAMMERS!**  
Get stronger and more powerful hammers to forge even tougher eggs!

🔥 Keep forging, keep upgrading, and become the ultimate Egg Blacksmith!

**Can you forge the strongest egg in the world?**

llm.loop: hammer eggs to forge them stronger -> upgrade egg rarity -> hatch eggs -> collect money from hatched creatures -> buy better hammers
llm.objectives: forge the strongest egg and become the ultimate Egg Blacksmith
llm.progression: egg rarity tiers (common to supernova), hammer upgrades, money
llm.instructions: forge eggs with your hammer, upgrade them, hatch them, earn money, buy better hammers
unique: forging/blacksmithing applied to eggs before hatching
llm.thumbnails: Roblox character hammering a glowing egg on an anvil; character running from a large lava monster while holding a glowing egg
llm.complexity_notes: simple tycoon-style map, egg tier UI, hatching; treadmill implies a strength layer
